entries.clue: Sprung stick ridden down the pavement in bounces
Pivoted plank that lifts one rider exactly as the other sinks
Salazar's cunning house, green and silver with a snake for its badge
Wooden tooth on a mill's great gear, meshing with the next as it turns
School of Witchcraft and Wizardry reached from platform nine and three-quarters
The bespectacled Boy Who Lived himself
Corn carted in for grinding, proverbially useful to the mill
Playground challenge no chicken will accept, sometimes issued double
Carrying surplus water off low marshland, the whole point of a Broads mill
Bladed rotor driven by wind or steam, modern heir to the sailed tower
